prompt_en: Make a complex photographic scene with a reference-guided subject, an unmistakably adult woman inhabiting an observable pose during a quiet winter pause in a tidal observatory map room. Use the supplied portrait as a visible face and hair appearance guide: short dark bob, wispy center-parted fringe, brown eyes, soft facial contours and pink lips. She has just arranged a folded coastal chart and looks toward the nearby camera with a calm, lightly parted mouth. She wears a sage linen shirt with a relaxed open collar and pushed-up sleeves, charcoal cropped wool trousers, and bare feet. She sits cross-legged on a broad low timber chart platform: her pelvis rests on its horizontal surface, both knees bend outward, her lower legs cross in front of her pelvis, and each foot tucks close beneath the opposite lower thigh while both ankles and feet remain visible. Her bare ankles continue visibly from their respective shins, while the timber top carries the whole folded-leg arrangement. Her torso leans slightly toward her left side. Her connected left shoulder, upper arm, lightly bent elbow and forearm lead to an open left palm planted beside and slightly behind her left hip. The palm heel lies flush on the wood and all five fingers fan along the surface, visibly bracing the lean. Her right hand rests lightly on the folded chart across her right upper thigh; a plain graphite pencil lies separately on the platform. A sea-facing window, shallow chart drawers and one muted wall map establish the working room. Low winter sunlight rakes the linen, cheek and timber while cooler skylight retains detail in her left arm and hand. Photograph from knee height at a front-left three-quarter position, with a natural 50mm perspective and a full seated frame from head through both feet and the platform edge. The near palm contact, wrist, elbow, crossed shins and ankle junctions occupy clear readable space. Let the woman's paused asymmetric presence lead, with the coastal room settling into the background.
